title: SK Hynix Said to Mull Options for $3 Billion Chongqing Plant
summary: South Korea’s SK Hynix Inc. is considering options for its Chongqing, China-based facility, including bringing in an investor to help accelerate growth, according to people with knowledge of the matter.

title: OpenAI Pauses Some Work on New Astra Model on Cyber Concerns
summary: OpenAI is pausing some internal work around one of its upcoming artificial intelligence models to implement stricter safeguards after the system was found to be significantly more adept at cybersecurity tasks.

title: Data Center Firm Switch to File Confidentially for IPO
summary: Switch Inc. filed confidentially for a US IPO, according to people familiar with the matter, joining its data center peers in tapping demand for exposure to the artificial intelligence theme.

title: SoftBank-Backed 3D Printer Maker Formlabs Said to Weigh IPO
summary: Formlabs, a maker of 3D printers, is in early talks with potential advisers for an initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: PGA Tour CEO Exclusive and David Kelly Talks Investing | Bloomberg Money 8/7/2026
summary: Bloomberg Money takes the pulse of your financial life, powered by the reporting of our global newsroom. Today's guests: Meredith Whitney Advisory Group CEO Meredith Whitney, JPMorgan Asset Management Chief Global Strategist David Kelly, and PGA Tour CEO Brian Rolapp. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Spelman President on Federal Funding, AI Popularity
summary: Spelman College President, Dr. Ayanna Howard, sits down with Romaine Bostick to discuss the impact of federal funding rollbacks for HBCUs, and the impact of AI on college graduates. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Akamai CEO on Earnings, Cloud Industry, New Investment
summary: Akamai's shares declined following the release of its second-quarter earnings report, despite the company beating earnings estimates. Tom Leighton, Co-Founder and CEO of Akamai, joined the program to discuss the company's performance and recent developments. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Gen CEO on Earnings, New Cybersecurity Attack Tracker
summary: Gen Digital's shares are reaching their highest levels in nearly a year following an upward revision of its earnings forecast. Vincent Pilette, President and CEO of Gen Digital, expressed strong confidence in sustaining double-digit growth over the coming quarters, driven by increased demand for cybersecurity solutions amid growing concerns related to AI and agentic technologies. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Sanctions Iranian Crypto Exchanges As Talks Continue
summary: The US ramped up economic pressure on Iran with more sanctions targeting digital asset exchanges and networks connected to the country’s shadow-banking system, as Washington seeks leverage amid ongoing negotiations over the war.

title: JPMorgan Boosts Tech Bond Sales Outlook as AI Debt Binge Expands
summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. sees bond sales from technology-related firms exceeding half a trillion dollars this year, as hyperscalers’ appetite to deploy capital for the artificial intelligence buildout shows no sign of abating despite growing investor fatigue.

title: CAIS CEO Talks New Funding Round, AI’s Fintech Impact
summary: Matt Brown, Founder, Chairman, and CEO of CAIS, discussed the company's recent $170 million Series D funding round led by Vista and supported by AllianzBernstein, Blue Owl, and Carlyle, which values the alternative asset investment platform at over $2 billion—more than double its previous valuation. Brown highlighted CAIS's 37% organic growth and explained that the new capital will be used to pursue strategic mergers and acquisitions in response to ongoing fintech industry consolidation, enhance AI capabilities to improve the platform's user experience for advisers and asset managers, and provide liquidity to long-term shareholders through an institutional tender offer facilitated by Nasdaq Private Markets. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Jobs Shock Sends Stocks Higher | Open Interest 8/7/2026
summary: Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Stocks rise after data showed US employers unexpectedly cut jobs in July. Meanwhile, oil wavers as prospects for a lasting agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz remain elusive. National Economic Council Director Kevin Hassett, BlackRock’s Rick Rieder and Julia Coronado of MacroPolicy Perspectives react to the surprising jobs report and what it means for the economy and Fed policy. Tanger CEO Stephen Yalof offers a read on the consumer. Plus, Ethan Allen Chairman & CEO Farooq Kathwari responds to an activist campaign seeking to replace the company’s entire board. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Jobs, AI, and Tech Earnings | Bloomberg Tech 8/07/2026
summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down the latest jobs data, as US employers unexpectedly cut jobs in July and questions grow over AI’s role in the labor market. Plus, the CEOs of Twilio, Lyft, and DraftKings join to discuss their latest earnings. And, OpenAI’s first consumer device is taking shape, an AI smart speaker designed to look like a doughnut. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Why Twilio Sees More AI Upside Ahead
summary: Twilio shares surged after the cloud communications company beat expectations and delivered record profitability and free cash flow. CEO Khozema Shipchandler joins Bloomberg to explain why AI is still only a modest contributor to revenue today, how Twilio’s global communications infrastructure creates a competitive moat, and why he sees agentic AI as a long-term tailwind for the business. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: World Cup Gives DraftKings a New Growth Engine
summary: DraftKings shares rallied as investors looked beyond a disappointing quarter to stronger momentum heading into the second half of the year. CEO Jason Robins joins Bloomberg to discuss how the World Cup brought in new and returning customers, why engagement remained strong after the tournament ended, and how DraftKings is approaching the increasingly competitive prediction-markets business. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Why Take-Two Won’t Share ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ Pre-Order Numbers
summary: CEO Strauss Zelnick says he doesn’t want to mislead shareholders

title: GTA VI Preorders Are ‘Unprecedented,’ Take-Two Says
summary: Take-Two shares climbed after quarterly bookings beat estimates, but investors remain focused on the biggest event in the company’s pipeline, the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI. Bloomberg’s Jason Schreier discusses what Take-Two is calling “unprecedented” preorder demand, why expectations for the game are so high, and what to watch for when Rockstar unveils an extended look at GTA VI gameplay ahead of its November release. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: FCC Removes Nationwide Cap Limiting Local TV Ownership
summary:
The Federal Communications Commission voted along party lines Thursday to repeal a nationwide audience cap that historically has limited the number of TV-viewing households a single broadcaster could reach. 
FCC Chairman Brendan Carr led the vote overturning two decades of precedent in favor of a new case-by-case approach and teeing up a legal issue that is almost certainly headed for federal appeals court. Bloomberg's Matthew Schettenhelm joined Bloomberg Intelligence to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: EU Accelerates Sovereign Satellite Plans Citing Defense Needs
summary: The European Union said it’s bulking up plans for a sovereign satellite constellation and will accelerate its service launch by a year to 2029, citing a changing security environment that will require greater communication capacity.

title: Lyft Is Transforming Into a Global Brand, CEO Says
summary: Lyft CEO David Risher discusses the company's growth compared to Waymo, its plans to expand internationally and where Lyft is focused internally. He speaks with Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
